title: Fading Light — Offer the same finite light at three different spacings
help: Each recipe starts at seventy percent and offers two more full pulses of the same amount. Only the spacing changes. The cap may reject offered light, and the final pulse arrives at a different time. Update ninety-six compares what remains, not the sum offered. Applying does not run the clock.
message: bursts experiments keep the supplied choices silent and reversible
facts: All three offer initial.7 plus TWO additional.7 pulses, total2.1 offered units, NOT held light/sample sum/exposure. Fields retention/retention-b/pulse-spacing/pulse-amount/pulse-pattern/pulse-count/update-rate/decay-unit/frame exactly as fixture. Native spacing12/24/48, count2 and frame0..120 exist. L0=.7; for i1..96,L=min(1,.9*previous+(.7 if i%spacing==0 and i/spacing<=2 else0)). RetentionB remains.995, rate30, decayunitupdate. Only recipes/data/helpers/import queries change.
